answer: Require every agent identity to post a refundable stake before it can trade, so each fake identity costs real capital instead of being free. A reputation signal then tracks how that stake behaves: honest work earns attestations, while spam or fraud triggers slashing that burns the bond. Like a sonnet written under strict form, the constraint forces discipline, and like crossing a tundra on foot, spinning up a thousand fake identities becomes slow and expensive — the attacker pays per identity while the network keeps only the ones that prove useful.
